h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagpur

items.pText: Nagpur summers are among the hottest in India, and anyone planning a playground here should start with the sun. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Nagpur's schools, housing societies and public gardens from our factory in Vasai, about 670 km away on the other side of Maharashtra.

We have been making play equipment since 2002 and have more than 15,000 installations across India. For Nagpur and the wider Vidarbha region, we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer. Before we manufacture anything, you see a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for every piece, so the committee can approve the plan knowing how much space it needs.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

attrs.className: fs-24 alt-font text-dark-gray d-block fw-600 ls-minus-1px mb-0

c: Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

From April to early June, afternoon temperatures in Nagpur make bare metal and dark plastic uncomfortable to touch. Choose lighter colours for slides and decks, and place them facing north or east. A shade structure over the main play station lets children use it in the evening without waiting for the surface to cool.
Rubber flooring stays softer and cooler than concrete or hard, dry earth. Water the surrounding lawn in the evening, not the equipment, so moving parts do not stay wet.

Nagpur's schools often have large grounds, so they can place separate zones for nursery and primary children. Housing societies in the newer areas around the city usually want a compact play station near the clubhouse.
Our
Play Lands
multi play stations combine slides, climbers and decks in one unit. Schools that want something different can look at the
Timeless Play
structures from our Funplay Originals range.
Clubhouse play areas work best when parents can sit nearby in the shade, so plan benches into the layout from the start.

Gardens maintained by the Nagpur Municipal Corporation see heavy evening use once the heat drops. Simple, sturdy pieces such as swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds suit them, grouted into concrete so they stay firm. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic come through the July to September monsoon without rusting.
For adults and walkers in the same garden, see our
outdoor gym equipment in Nagpur
. In Maharashtra we have also completed a project for Raymond in Thane.

Most Nagpur projects start with a few site photos sent on email or phone. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing. Once the layout and quote are approved, our factory makes the equipment and dispatches it by road across Maharashtra.
Our team or a local dealer installs it with the method that suits your ground. Hard, dry soil is common in the region, and grouting into a concrete base keeps the posts firm through the year.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Nagpur?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, send the equipment to Nagpur by road and install it with our own installation team or a local dealer. Vidarbha sites are reached by road from Vasai across the state.

items.q: Will the equipment get too hot in Nagpur's summer?
items.a: Any surface in direct sun gets hot. Choose lighter colours, place slides away from the afternoon sun and add shade over the main structure. Children can then use it comfortably in the evening.

items.q: Which equipment suits a large school ground?
items.a: A multi play station for younger children, and swings, climbers and see-saws for older pupils, spread across separate zones. Share the ground size and we will propose a layout.

The frame and plastic parts are covered for three years, including galvanised pipes, composite laminates and play rope. Springs and bearings are covered for one year. The cover is for manufacturing defects on equipment installed and maintained our way.
